source_text: Analogies to female genital mutilation (FGM) underscore non-consensual parallels: both entail cultural or parental imposition of genital excision on minors, altering healthy anatomy without therapeutic imperative, yet FGM faces universal condemnation while male circumcision evades equivalent scrutiny.
